vPStats.description:
A list of dictionaries containing stats for each violin plot. Required keys are:
(matplotlib vpstats)

Python: list of dicts

positions.description:
Sets the positions of the violins. The ticks and limits are automatically set to match the positions.

Python: array-like

vert.description: If true, plots the violins veritcally. Otherwise, plots the violins horizontally.

widths.description:
Either a scalar or a vector that sets the maximal width of each violin. The default is 0.5, which uses about half of the available horizontal space.

Python: array-like

showMeans.description:
If true, will toggle rendering of the means.
(matplotlib showmeans)

showExtrema.description:
If true, will toggle rendering of the extrema.
(matplotlib showextrema)

showMedians.description:
If true, will toggle rendering of the medians.
(matplotlib showmedians)

name: PlotViolinSpec
